The content reviewer obtains PostgreSQL from review_983910d461c2a2e15565b1dc in an AWS repository describing an unspecified GCP event. No canonical same-project identity was established between that secondary source and the named Google Cloud AI Traffic Safety Platform claim. PostgreSQL component license is therefore not established by this claim.
